title: Chapter 197 Incomplete Report (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 197 Incomplete Report (Part 3)

These four people did not enter the Dragon King Underground Palace through the dungeon entrance like Wang Shuo did, but entered through a single-person teleportation scroll.

Moreover, the four people did not know each other and entered at different times.

The first to come was the black-clad assassin Shi Lisha. She got this teleportation scroll shortly after the battle for the village construction order started. She thought that this place should have a great opportunity, and she, who was only level 5, teleported in without hesitation.

But the undead here, who were more than level 30, directly put her in a desperate situation.

If she had not learned an invisibility skill long ago, she might have been killed the moment she came in.

With the help of the invisibility skill, she found many resources here and successfully raised her level to more than level 20, but she still couldn't fight the boss here alone.

The female warrior, called Yinghua Guzi, had been here for two days. When she first came here, she was also a little scared. She couldn't even beat the weakest undead guard alone. Fortunately, she got the help of Shi Lisha and survived until now.

Until the white-clothed girl Ye Xueer and the yellow-haired man Locke joined, they formed a team to kill the guards and began to explore some dangerous places.

In this dangerous underground palace of the Dragon King, the few people had no choice but to temporarily join forces to fight the enemy.

...

Dining hall.

Wang Shuo pondered for a while, thinking that someone had taken the lead, he shook his head helplessly and walked out expressionlessly.

Next, Wang Shuo planned to go to the Ministry of Internal Affairs first to see if there was anything to gain.

In the back garden, the original plants in the flowerbed were basically withered, leaving only the black soil infected by death, but it was not that there were no living plants.

There was a kind of black vine that grew wantonly, and death seemed to be its best nutrient.

Wang Shuo passed through a corner of the back garden through the map and came to the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

The dilapidated lintel no longer had the former style, and the pillars at the door had long lost their old color.

However, there were still soldiers guarding the door, but they had become undead.

There was nothing much to say. After clearing the guards, he stepped into the gate of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

Inside was a three-entry courtyard.

Wang Shuo killed dozens of guards in a row and finally came to the treasury.

However, it was empty inside, and nothing was left.

It was not that nothing was left, at least there was a boss left.

[Silver Boss, General Manager of Internal Affairs Raymond]

[Level: Level 39]

[Attack Power: 400]

[Defense Power: 260]

[Health Points: 4800]

This Raymond did not do anything strange, and Wang Shuo and his subordinates killed him without any danger.

[You killed General Manager of Internal Affairs Raymond. ]

[Obtained the incomplete report (three), and the progress of the side quest was 25%. ]

Another animation appeared in front of him.

Xianhe Town.

In a luxurious hall, dozens of young girls danced gracefully.

On the seats around, several men in gorgeous clothes were drinking and having fun.

At this moment, a soldier walked in.

"Report to the garrison commander, someone from Pianqiao Village sent a letter for help, saying that the village was attacked by skeleton soldiers."

The garrison commander lay comfortably on the thighs of the two girls, not taking the soldier's report seriously at all.

He said lazily: "I know, go down!"

And then, nothing happened.

The scene ends here.

Wang Shuo was really angry with this fat and big-eared garrison commander.

He didn't even mean to send someone to investigate, and he ignored life to such an extent.

After a long while, Wang Shuo calmed down.

Then he sneered, what kind of care did he have.

This happened a thousand years ago, and it was a bit ridiculous for him to look like this.
